name: Lemon-Herb Pork Chop with Feta & Greek Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes
3 yellow bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic; add oil and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp basil, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place in a large baking dish. Pour marinade over the chops, turn to coat, and set aside. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
While the chops are marinating, peel and mince additional garlic; place in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers; medium dice tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Thinly slice olives and add to the bowl; stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add chops and marinade; pan-fry until golden brown on one side, 3-4 minutes.

Flip chops and sprinkle the top side with half of the feta (reserve remaining feta for the salad). Continue to pan-fry until cheese has softened and chops are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chops and salad between plates; top salad with reserved feta and enjoy!
